title: Direct Sum of Supercuspidal Data
body_html:
Direct Sum of Supercuspidal Data

Suppose \(\{\Sigma_l:0\le l\le b\}\) is a collection of single-block supercuspidal data for hermitian spaces \(V_l\), with \(\Sigma_0\) of depth zero and the positive depths strictly ordered \[ r_b>\ldots>r_1>0. \] On the orthogonal direct sum \[ V=\bigoplus_{l=0}^{b}V_l, \] define \(x,\Gamma,\phi,\rho\) by direct sum or exterior tensor product on the corresponding factors. Then \[ \Sigma=\bigoplus_{l=0}^{b}\Sigma_l \] is a supercuspidal datum for \(U(V)\). This construction is inverse to the block decomposition at the level of equivalence classes.
